ownership: New allocates one stable native cell, then duplicates one actual external strong object root. The embedded weak record is reserved in that allocation.
SetWeak links the real object weak chain before dropping the strong root; it accesses no cell storage after retirement can call a native finalizer.
Object disposal removes and clears native records before property or class finalizers. Original WeakMap/WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry two-pass cleanup remains unchanged.
Get returns one owned temporary Local or undefined. It neither allocates nor appends to kept_objects and rejects targets already queued with zero refs or marked for cycle removal.
Free unlinks the weak record or releases the strong owner after publishing disposing/undefined; the cell remains allocated through reentrant native cleanup.
Only actual pending reasons participate in release reduction. Retained flagged DATA is never promoted by New/Get/Free in the absence of an actual throw.
The selected API is object-only, VM-thread-only, with unique caller cell ownership, and every cell must be freed before its runtime.
